name: AI Content Automation
description: A fully automated AI-powered tool that writes scripts, generates voiceovers, creates videos, and uploads them automatically to YouTube for hands-free channel growth.

inputs.name: topic
inputs.description: Subject or theme for the content generation pipeline.

inputs.name: script_parameters
inputs.description: Optional parameters to customize script writing such as tone, length, style.

inputs.name: voiceover_settings
inputs.description: Settings for voice synthesis including voice selection, language, speed.

inputs.name: video_templates
inputs.description: Video style or template selection for creating the visual content.

inputs.name: upload_credentials
inputs.description: Authentication and configuration data to upload videos to YouTube.

outputs.name: script
outputs.description: AI-generated script content based on the input topic.

outputs.name: voiceover_audio
outputs.description: Synthetic voice narration generated from the script.

outputs.name: video_file
outputs.description: Final rendered video combining script, voiceover, and visuals.

outputs.name: upload_status
outputs.description: Result status and metadata after automatic YouTube upload.

patterns: AI-driven script writing from topic input
Pipeline orchestration for end-to-end content automation
steps: Receive topic and optional customization parameters from the user
Generate a detailed script using AI text generation models
Create a voiceover audio track by converting the script text to speech
Combine script, voiceover, and video templates to produce a final video
Automatically upload the generated video to a linked YouTube channel
Provide status feedback and video metadata after upload
use_cases: YouTube creators seeking to automate video production workflow
Marketing teams generating consistent video content rapidly
Educators producing educational videos with minimal manual effort
Content marketers scaling video content for social media campaigns
Anyone requiring hands-free AI-powered video content creation and distribution

prompt_templates.name: script_generation
prompt_templates.template: Write a detailed and engaging script about {topic} with a {tone} tone and approximately {length} words.

prompt_templates.name: voiceover_generation
prompt_templates.template: Generate a voiceover narration for the following script using {voice} voice at {speed} speed: {script}

prompt_templates.name: video_creation
prompt_templates.template: Create a video using the script and voiceover with the following template style: {template_style}

prompt_templates.name: youtube_upload
prompt_templates.template: Upload the video titled '{title}' with description '{description}' and tags {tags} to the YouTube channel.
